title: skills: the package customizations read also lists arrangements (objectstack-platform SKILL.md)
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi4PechTRCTBrfxV8W

Found in L1 of PR #36818 (#36626, the package customizations read lists tab arrangements; L1 7120715954, item S1). Filed by seat 3, not claimed.

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:skills`

## What happens

`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` (around line 129) says the package customizations read "lists its overrides, extensions and switched-off items". After #36626 the read also lists `arrangements` (an extension's `relatedLists` and `fieldGroups` arrangements). PR #36818 corrects the same sentence in `content/docs/**/metadata-api.mdx`; the skill still teaches the old list, so an AI author reading the skill does not know arrangements are reported.

## Ask

Reword that sentence to match `metadata-api.mdx` after #36818 lands (the four kinds, including arrangements). `skills/**` is governed: the PR lands by the approver.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "switched-off items" skills/` shows the sentence naming arrangements.

Blocked-by: #36818
